# Testing rules (enforced by tools/guards: T1xx-T3xx)

## Shape of every test (`tests/**/test_*.py`)
```python
async def test_aget_returns_same_instance_as_sync(readonly_db, differential):
    # given
    build = partial(Book.objects.filter, title="book-1")
    # when
    result = await differential(build)
    # then
    assert result.async_outcome == result.sync_outcome
```
- Markers `# given`, `# when`, `# then` in that order, each at most once. `# given` may be
  omitted only when nothing happens before `# when`. Use `# when / then` for `pytest.raises`.
  Optional trailing text is allowed: `# given: an author without books`.
- At least one assertion after `# then` (`assert`, `pytest.raises`, or an `assert_*` helper).
- One behaviour per test. Name: `test_<subject>_<condition>_<expected>`.

## Absolutely no control flow in test modules
`for`, `async for`, `while`, `if`, conditional expressions, `match`, `try`, and all
comprehensions are forbidden anywhere in a test module - no exceptions, no suppressions.
- Variation -> `@pytest.mark.parametrize` with literal values, or Hypothesis `@given`.
- Setup logic -> fixtures in `conftest.py` or helpers in `tests/support/`.
- Iterating an async iterator -> `await collect(aiter)` from `tests/support`.
- No `sleep` in tests; await a condition via a support helper.

## Layout
| Dir | Needs | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `tests/unit/` | nothing | pure Python; no DB access (pytest-django blocks it) |
| `tests/integration/` | `make db-up` | auto-marked `integration`; runs per backend via `ASYNCOPATION_DB` |
| `tests/e2e/` | `make db-up` | boots uvicorn on the harness site; auto-marked `e2e` |
| `tests/support/` | - | the only place for helper logic; has its own unit tests when non-trivial |

## Database isolation
Async connections cannot see the sync test transaction, so pytest-django's default
`django_db` rollback isolation does **not** apply to code under test.
- Read-only tests use the `readonly_db` fixture: the deterministic seed (`harness/seed.py`)
  is committed once per session. Never write in these tests.
- Tests that write use `writable_db`; it re-seeds (committed) after the test.

## Differential testing is the default for read APIs
For every read API compare against the sync ORM with the `differential` fixture
(see the `differential-testing` skill). Snapshots compare model, pk, every concrete field,
value **and type**, and order. Add Hypothesis strategies when adding QuerySet features.

## Backends
Every integration test must pass on postgresql, mysql and mariadb. Backend-specific behaviour
is expressed with parametrize ids or separate tests marked
`@pytest.mark.skipif(VENDOR != ..., reason=...)` - never with `if` in the test body.
